name: evoarena-frozen-v3
goal: Fix repository membership and language counts, then shuffle repository blocks independently within train and test
selection: One longest original complete chain per repository; require full unique-task coverage
rationale: Freeze repository membership and language counts before experiments; do not resample the split when changing order seeds.
Keep both Go and Python in training and testing, with whole repositories assigned to one partition only.
Use fully cached repositories because local storage cannot accommodate the remaining environments.
Sort repository names canonically, then shuffle independently within each seeded partition; preserve each original chain's chronology.
Use the same frozen task manifests for all methods and skill controls; retain exact original task and grading metadata.
Report checkpoints after four, five and six complete training repositories; their task counts follow the seeded order.
Keep incomplete nats-server and prometheus repositories in reserve, including the two already cached nats tasks.
This resource-constrained pilot preserves the previous 70/45 membership and does not establish broad multilingual generalization.
